experiment: Phase 4.3 finite-shot local QAOA sampling diagnostic
methodology_note: This is a local statevector probability-sampling experiment. It does not execute on IBM Quantum hardware and does not demonstrate quantum advantage. Finite-shot sampling approximates the measurement process of a quantum processor.
limitations: The instances are controlled deterministic variations, not physical measurements.
The local statevector distribution is sampled classically; no IBM hardware noise is modeled.
Observed feasible solutions depend on the deterministic finite-shot seeds and shot counts.
